title: Sancton article: High Society, Stearns, Bolden and the Paddock opening
summary: Reading a clipping about Picou and Glenny, the Imperial band with Manuel Perez, how Picou worked out the High Society solo, the Paddock opening in 1949 and Marshall Stearns's visit.
